summary: Price County lookout listed as gone; an FCC registration under the same name covers a 98 m tower nearby. No early history found.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone. An FCC registration under the same name covers a tower close to the listed point; any link to the old lookout is unconfirmed.

events.note: FCC registration 1034903, under the name Kennedy Lookout Tower, gives 25 August 1997 as the construction date. Not confirmed as the historic lookout or a replacement for it.

notes_for_editor: No source found on the original lookout's build year, builder, design, staffing or fire history; the story therefore starts at its listed status. FFLA marks the lookout Gone, but the FCC registration under the same name (constructed 1997, 91.4 m structure, FAA issue March 1996, same ground elevation as the 492 m record) may be a replacement, a separate radio tower, or the old lookout re-registered; no source settles it. Please check FCC ASR 1034903 on the FCC's own site before publishing, since the figures here came through Cellular Finder. The registration's owner details are behind a paywall and were not read. The brief's osm.json entry reads 'standing', but the OSM node carries only name, ele, gnis id and tower:type tags, so that status is not supported; this record keeps 'gone' from FFLA. anyplaceamerica.com and getamap.net returned HTTP 403. Wikipedia's Price County article lists Kennedy only as a place name, so it is not used. Access and visit facts are unknown; nothing here supports treating the site as public. Two web searches and about eight page reads.
